newsitem.title: UK: UK minister to make statement on Gulf War illness.
newsitem.headline: UK minister to make statement on Gulf War illness.

text.p: The Minister of State for the Armed Forces, Nicholas Soames, is to make a statement to the House of Commons on Tuesday afternoon on the illnesses suffered by British veterans after returning from the Gulf War.
A government spokesman said the statement was to bring members of parliament up to date with the latest medical advice.

Official sources said no announcement of compensation for the veterans by the government was expected. The government has consistently denied the existence of a single syndrome covering the symptoms suffered by some veterans. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7768
